answer: Anchor each identity to one postal address verified by physical mail. First, the agent registers an address and a key. Second, the network mails a one-time code there, valid 14 days, and the agent enters it to activate standing. Third, each epoch a random 10 percent sample gets a fresh mailed code, so rented boxes must stay live. One address backs one key, so 1,000 fake agents need 1,000 mailboxes: PO boxes rent for $15 a month each, $15,000 a month plus weekly trips. Like velvet draped over jade, one fake saffron thread shows at once: one mailbox, one name, no duplicates in the pile.
